description.value: Resting-state EPI data were processed with DPARSF V3.1 based on SPM8 and REST V1.8: the first 10 time points were removed, slice timing and rigid-body motion correction were performed, images were normalized to MNI space at 3 mm isotropic resolution, and smoothed with a 6 mm FWHM Gaussian kernel. Subjects exceeding 1 mm movement or 1° rotation were excluded; ROI-to-whole-brain correlations were Fisher z-transformed.
